Marsriva 2kW Off Grid Hybrid Solar Package

The Marsriva 2kW Off-Grid Hybrid Solar Package provides solar power for homes requiring essential electricity during power outages. This off-grid solar package combines a hybrid solar inverter, a LiFePO4 battery, and a high-output bifacial solar panel. It supports essential household appliances, including LED lights, ceiling fans, an inverter-type refrigerator, a television, a Wi-Fi router, and a laptop or computer. With its solar charging capability and battery storage, this Solar Package helps reduce reliance on grid electricity. The system suits households seeking a compact solar solution for backup power and daily energy needs. It can support selected appliances in a 3-4 bedroom solar setup, depending on total consumption and simultaneous usage. The actual backup time depends on the connected load, battery condition, and operating conditions. This Solar IPS package offers a suitable option for homes needing an alternative electricity source. Its hybrid design supports solar energy utilization and battery-powered operation when grid electricity is unavailable.

Hybrid Solar Inverter and High-Efficiency Solar Panel

The Marsriva MR-SPF2K-LP1-TL20E 2kW Hybrid Solar Inverter manages solar power conversion and battery charging. This hybrid inverter supports a solar system designed for essential home appliances and backup electricity. The JinKo 66HL4M-BDV 620W N-Type Bifacial Module Dual Glass Solar Panel supplies solar energy to the system. Its 625W rated output supports solar electricity generation when sunlight conditions are suitable. N-type cell technology and a bifacial, dual-glass construction form part of the panel's design.

Battery Capacity and Estimated Backup Time

The Marsriva MR-LBP12-200-LAR 12.8V 200Ah LiFePO4 Solar Battery stores electricity for use when solar generation is insufficient or grid power is unavailable. It features a 12.8V nominal voltage and a 200Ah capacity, providing approximately 2.56kWh of nominal stored energy. Usable energy depends on the battery's operating limits, conversion losses, and system settings. This battery supports essential appliances, including LED lighting, ceiling fans, an LED television, a refrigerator, a router, and a computer. The estimated backup time is 2 to 3 hours, depending on the connected load and operating conditions. The actual backup time also depends on battery charge level, inverter efficiency, and appliance starting loads.

Solar Package Includes

This 2kW Off-Grid Hybrid Solar Package includes 1 unit of Marsriva MR-SPF2K-LP1-TL20E 2kW Hybrid Solar Inverter, 1 unit of Marsriva MR-LBP12-200-LAR 12.8V 200Ah LiFePO4 Solar Battery, and 2 units of JinKo 66HL4M-BDV 620W N-Type Bifacial Module Dual Glass Solar Panel. It provides a total solar panel capacity of 1,250W. This system offers an efficient solar power solution with battery storage for reliable electricity and backup power.
